findings.title: Eleven Palestinians, including women and children, reportedly injured in shelling of a home in Gaza City's Al-Tuffah neighborhood
findings.location: Near Al-Sanafour (Sanfur) junction, Al-Tuffah neighborhood, northeastern Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: 11 Palestinians reportedly injured, including women and children; Palestine Red Crescent Society ambulance teams reportedly transported 11 injured people to Al-Saraya field hospital in Gaza City

findings.source_type: Established news outlet, Arabic agency-compiled reporting attributing medical transport to a Palestine Red Crescent Society statement; PRCS original statement was not directly retrieved

bounded_discovery_context.verification: Al Jazeera Arabic article directly read (29 Oct 2026); article describes this event before 'earlier Wednesday' incidents, consistent with a fresh Thursday report, but does not independently timestamp the shelling or posting. PRCS attributed 11 casualty transport; official PRCS site did not show this statement in its public homepage news list.
bounded_discovery_context.deduplication: Previous 22:50:49.871 PDT Gaza heartbeat lists no finding and covered pre-29 Oct Gaza reports. Earlier Gaza City artillery report from live update (27 Oct source date) counted seven injured but lacked exact location and incident time; cannot prove incident non-overlap. Do not sum the eleven with the seven or totals in the compilation. Treat as newly surfaced distinct Al-Tuffah home-shelling report pending editorial cross-check.
bounded_discovery_context.limits: Exact incident/publication hour and independent PRCS statement unavailable; article's 5 deaths and ~40 injuries aggregate repeats multiple 28 Oct incidents, not promoted as new.
